For Yahweh says, “The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end.
While they were killing, and I was left, I fell on my face, and cried, and said, “Ah Lord Yahweh! Will you destroy all…
When I prophesied, Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then I fell down on my face, and cried with a loud voice, and…

translations.web: “But even in those days,” says Yahweh, “I will not make a full end of you.
translations.bsb: “Yet even in those days,” declares the LORD, “I will not make a full end of you.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless in those days, saith the LORD, I will not make a full end
translations.asv: But even in those days, saith Jehovah, I will not make a full end with you.
